description: Ex-Kuwait Air Force Jet Provost trainer reported at Bait Al-Othman Museum: 248am.com (2013) noted 'a plane' displayed in the museum car park; tristaraviation.org (Feb 2020) states the Jet Provost, previously kept outside, had been moved into a new exhibition hall then under construction, and called Bait Al-Othman the only public museum in Kuwait displaying aircraft. Serial and mark unknown; no photograph found. Needs on-site confirmation.
aliases: JP; Jet Provost T.51; Jet Provost T.52
